question: At exactly lambda=0, can the smooth differentiated Wronskian endpoint J(Q0)=-W(u,partial_lambda u)(Q0)=u(Q0)^2 h(Q0) be certified on all five characteristic brackets by the exact Green integral without evolving the pole-prone quotient h through possible nodes?

upstream_results.role: pins the exact lambda-zero recessive Bessel direction, full root brackets, and nonzero endpoint K bands
pins the normalization-invariant h(4) boxes used only to reconstruct the smooth plus-end Wronskian J(4)=u(4)^2h(4)

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel order symmetry, derivative recurrence and integral representation, sections 10.27, 10.29 and 10.32
primary_sources.used_for: the exact lambda-zero K representation, endpoint derivative formula, reality for imaginary order on positive x, and the K integral-representation tail majorant
primary_sources.not_used_for: nonzero-lambda transport, an endpoint amplitude F_lambda, root uniqueness, spectral data or RAQ

primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic
primary_sources.not_used_for: the Green/Wronskian identity or any raw-C operator conclusion

primary_sources.source: python-flint acb complex-ball integration and special-function interface
primary_sources.used_for: locked rigorous finite acb.integral enclosures of the smooth Bessel-square Green density
primary_sources.not_used_for: unbounded numerical quadrature or treating precision repeats as independent validation

declared_conventions.plus_tail_magnitude_sanity: J(Qplus)=u(Qplus)^2*h(Qplus), reconstructed only as a positive smooth-Wronskian scale sentinel and not as a Qplus-to-Q0 decomposition check
declared_conventions.conditional_finite_Q0_proxy_identity: if the finite-Q0 lambda-zero proxy F_0(kappa)=u_Q(Q0;kappa)=0, then partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0)=-J(Q0)/u(Q0)^2=-h(Q0); this is not identified with the declared raw-C Gamma_1(lambda) extension characteristic away from lambda=0
declared_conventions.quadrature_variable: x in the fixed positive-real subdivision [x0,1.5],[1.5,2],[2,4],[4,8],[8,16],[16,32]
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint/Arb Bessel balls and finite acb.integral on six predetermined positive-real subsegments; no ODE solve, root solve, finite difference, Riccati h evolution or unbounded numerical quadrature

assumptions: Every result is exactly at lambda=0 and covers each full upstream exact-rational kappa bracket, not a midpoint or a unique root.
J=-W(u,partial_lambda u) is smooth through zeros of u. The runner does not evolve or divide by h on the open Q interval; it divides by u only at Q0 after a whole-band nonzero certificate.
For real kappa and positive x, K_(i*kappa)(x) is real by conjugation and order symmetry. Full complex balls are retained during finite quadrature.
DLMF 10.32.9 and cosh(t)>=1+t^2/2 give |K_(i*kappa)(x)|<=exp(-x)*sqrt(pi/(2x)), used only for the manual x>=64 tail.

The h(4) upstream boxes and independently evaluated K(4) balls are combined only as a positive J(4) magnitude sanity check against a coarse tail allowance. This is not a decomposition or propagation check; the endpoint J(Q0) certificate is the direct Green integral.
The two precision tiers use one locked backend and are consistency refinements, not independent implementations.

At a zero of the finite-Q0 lambda-zero proxy the ratio partial_lambda F_0/u(Q0) is normalization invariant, but it is not an eigenvalue slope for the declared raw-C extension: Gamma_1 is a minus-end Wronskian limit and its equality with u_Q(Q0) was pinned only at zero energy. The standalone amplitude, declared-extension derivative and all root velocities remain null.
tasks: verify both upstream hashes, payload hashes, verdicts and VALID_RUN states; load all five full certified brackets and h(4) boxes
verify exactly the forced Wronskian equation, J=-W=u^2h, the x-density, the direct node-safe Green identity, and the conditional endpoint-root identity

for each full bracket at 80 and 120 decimal digits, certify K_(i*kappa)(x0) excludes zero, acb-integrate sqrt(x)K_(i*kappa)(x)^2 on the six fixed subsegments from x0 to 32, sum their rigorous enclosures, and add the analytic improper-tail interval
reconstruct J(4)=K_(i*kappa)(xplus)^2*h(4) as a separately recorded positive magnitude sanity check without calling it a Qplus-to-Q0 decomposition or using it to replace the direct endpoint integral

form h(Q0)=J(Q0)/K_(i*kappa)(x0)^2 only after the endpoint denominator is certified nonzero; record its conditional finite-Q0-proxy interpretation without identifying it with a declared-extension eigenvalue slope
require positive finite integrals, finite positive tail, tier width limits, overlap and strict high-precision width refinement on every bracket
write raw h trajectory, endpoint F_lambda amplitude, root velocity, spectral, RAQ, BFV, physical and TOE outputs as explicit nulls

decision_table.condition: all source pins, exact identities, full-band endpoint denominators, finite quadratures, analytic tails, plus-end magnitude sanity checks, tier widths and refinement intersections pass for all five brackets
any source pin, identity, endpoint denominator, finite quadrature, analytic tail, plus-end magnitude sanity, width or refinement check fails
